summary: This report provides an update on the status of negotiations with Hydro One for the licensing of a portion of hydro right-of-way (ROW) for park use within the Emery Village Neighbourhood. The Emery Village Business Improvement Area (BIA) has produced detailed design drawings of a proposed park on the hydro ROW that would pay tribute to the First Nations history in the area. These park plans have changed slightly based on initial feedback from Hydro One. Emery Village BIA held three meetings with the First Nation communities for review and approval. As the future road identified in the Transportation Master Plan now aligns with the potential park design Parks, Forestry and Recreation (PFR) is supporting, Hydro One is prepared to review the City's submission. The proposed park has been approved by the three First Nation communities, therefore the Emery Village BIA will now submit a formal application to PFR for submission to Hydro One. The future development to the north will increase the local population, therefore the proposed park will offset pressures on existing parkland in the vicinity. PFR will continue to work with the BIA in a collaborative manor to secure the license with Hydro One.
decided: Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to continue to work with the Emery Village Business Improvement Area to advance the First Nations Park project and report to Etobicoke York Community Council.
